sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवो वाक्यमुवाच स महामुनीन् ।घातयिष्यामि तद्रक्षो ह्यपगच्छतु वो भयम् ।। ७.६२.६ ॥
transliteration: tacchrutvā rāghavo vākyamuvāca sa mahāmunīn ।ghātayiṣyāmi tadrakṣo hyapagacchatu vo bhayam ।। 7.62.6 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that, Rama spoke these words to the great sages: "I shall indeed kill that demon; let your fear depart."
